company.name: Center for a New American Security

profile_text.body:
Center for a New American Security (CNAS) is a nonprofit organization founded in 2007 and headquartered in Washington, DC. Its website describes the organization as developing strong, pragmatic and principled national security and defense policies.

The organization's site publishes commentary on artificial intelligence. It states that AI systems continue to progress at a steady pace, a trend that has fed forecasts about artificial general intelligence. It argues for lengthening the United States' AI lead by expanding technology protections, starting with closing three priority gaps, including remote access. The site also includes a statement that apart from a notification mechanism, there is almost zero chance of a meaningful U.S.-China AI safety dialogue.

Washington state records list 114 entries associated with the organization.
